# Libraries copied in

Copied from npm as they were published, unchanged, so the page needs no build step and loads
nothing from anywhere else. Check a copy with `npm pack <name>@<version>` and compare.

| File | What | Version | Licence | From |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qrcode.js` | Draws the code: QR Code Generator for JavaScript, by Kazuhiko Arase | 1.4.4 | MIT (in the file's header) | npm `qrcode-generator`, integrity `sha512-HM7yY8O2ilqhmULxGMpcHSF1EhJJ9yBj8gvDEuZ6M+KGJ0YY2hKpnXvRD+hZPLrDVck3ExIGhmPtSdcjC+guuw==` |
| `jsQR.js` | Reads the code back, for the check: jsQR, by Cosmo Wolfe | 1.4.0 (`dist/jsQR.js`) | Apache-2.0 (`jsQR.LICENSE.txt`) | npm `jsqr`, integrity `sha512-dxLob7q65Xg2DvstYkRpkYtmKm2sPJ9oFhrhmudT1dZvNFFTlroai3AWSpLey/w5vMcLBXRgOJsbXpdN9HzU/A==` |
